title: Roguelike Celebration 2022 Preview
description: Join us at Roguelike Celebration for our preview event in our custom social space! This year's preview features exclusive fireside chats with Casey Yano of Mega Crit (Slay the Spire) and Justin Ma of Subset Games (FTL: Faster than Light, Into the Breach). Check our website (https://www.roguelike.club/) for more info!
